title: Canary rollout notes - Maya Thompson
content:
Quick personal scratchpad for the canary rollout (model + runtime) we want to run this week. Draft, will sync with Priya/Jordan for test windows and final percentages.

Goal:
- Gradually route traffic to runtime v2024-10-1 + model redwood/llama-3-7b@v1.2.3 (quantized) and validate latency, correctness, and error profile.

High-level plan:
- Deploy runtime change to staging (done 2024-10-17). Smoke tests OK.
- Pin model variant in config: model: redwood/llama-3-7b@v1.2.3; fallback: redwood/llama-3-7b@v1.2.2 (non-quant).
- Traffic ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% (hold times below).

Rollout checklist (working):
- [ ] Finalize MTO (maintenance/time window) with SRE (avoid peak hours)
- [x] Staging validation: unit tests + integration smoke pass
- [ ] Create canary route in Redwood Console: route id canary/2024-10-llama3
- [ ] Add monitoring readers to dashboard (Jordan)
- [ ] Create alert runbook links in monitor (error rate > 1% or p95 latency +200ms)
- [ ] Post rollout QA checklist to #release-discuss

Stage hold times and success criteria:
- 1% for 30 mins: no increase in 5xx, no >5% increase in hallucination eval score on sanity set (eval id: CONFLUENCE-RT-4782)
- 5% for 45 mins: p95 latency within +10% of baseline, CPU/GPU utilization within expected bounds
- 10% for 60 mins: monitor client error rate and token cost delta (<+3%)
- 25% for 90 mins: run random samples through production eval harness, check top-5 prompts for regressions
- >25%: coordinate with product and CDM for slower ramp

Version pinning / config notes:
- Canary config snippet (for ops):
  - model_name: redwood/llama-3-7b
  - model_version: v1.2.3
  - quantization: int8
  - fallback_model: redwood/llama-3-7b@v1.2.2
  - rollout_policy: percentage
- Ensure model_id used in requests is the pinned id (do not rely on latest tag)
- Add a config flag `enable_canary_v2024_10` to toggle route without redeploying runtime

Monitoring / queries to run (placeholders):
- Error rate (total requests with 5xx): rate(http_requests_total{handler="generate"}[5m])
- P95 latency: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="canary/2024-10-llama3"}[5m])) by (le))
- Token consumption delta: compare tokens_per_request over last 1h to baseline
- Sample quality checks: run eval harness `evals/run_canary_checkpoint.sh` and diff against baseline outputs

Rollback plan:
- Manual rollback: flip canary route to fallback_model or set rollout_policy to 0%
- Automated safe-guard: if 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > baseline+500ms, auto-scale down to 0% (SRE will be notified)
- Post-rollback tasks: collect logs, create JIRA with `rollback` label, assign to runtime lead

Open questions / TODOs:
- Need to confirm evaluation prompts list with PM (Priya). Which product flows must be included in regressionsuite?
- Do we want to include streaming responses in canary? (streaming has different latency characteristics)
- Confirm whether cost telemetry for quantized variant is reporting correctly (I saw token cost mismatch in staging)
- Decide on final hold times + escalation steps for >25% ramp

Quick commands / links:
- Pin model via admin API (curl):
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood/inference/routes/canary/2024-10-llama3/pin -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood/llama-3-7b@v1.2.3","percent":1}'
- GH PR for runtime change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/312
- Staging eval job: /ci/evals/run-staging-canary.sh (ask Jordan if blocked)

Post-rollout validation (after 100%):
- Run full regression suite (overnight) and report any quality deltas > 0.5 AUC drop or >3% failure on critical prompts.
- Update release notes with pinned model version, quantization details, and observed perf/cost delta.

Notes to self:
- Keep the first two hold stages conservative (1%/5%) to catch config mismatches in low-traffic window.
- Coordinate with support for notify template in case users report content regressions.

References:
- CONFLUENCE-RT-4782: canary eval prompt list (work-in-progress)
- JIRA-9876: runtime model pinning epic
- Slack thread: #release-discuss (thread ts msg12345)

-- Maya
